name: HubSpot
summary: Building is self-serve, but since September 2025 new marketplace-distribution apps are capped at 25 installs until listed, and listing needs 3 active customer installs plus a review of up to about 2 months.
scenario: An agent that reads and updates CRM contacts, companies and deals in customers' HubSpot accounts.

composio.note: Check the Composio managed OAuth directory for the HubSpot toolkit.

policyAndDomain.detail: Listing requires marketplace listing materials; not needed for up to 25 installs.

userCapBeforeApproval.detail: Marketplace-distribution apps are capped at 25 installs until listed. Private distribution allows 10 portals (100 for Solutions Partners).

adminApproval.detail: Who in a customer account may install apps was not checked.

appReview.detail: Required only to exceed 25 installs (Marketplace listing).

time.note: Initial review within 10 business days; the full feedback process should take no more than 60 days. Only needed past 25 installs.

nextStep: Create a developer account and a project-based app with marketplace distribution, add your redirect URL and CRM scopes, and test on a free test account.

prerequisites.text: To list: at least 3 active, unique installs from production accounts not affiliated with you, with successful API activity in the past 30 days.

steps.title: Create a developer account and app
steps.detail: Create the app on the current developer platform and choose marketplace distribution if you'll serve many customers.

steps.title: Add redirect URL and scopes
steps.detail: Configure OAuth redirect URLs and required/optional CRM scopes.

steps.title: Install on a test account
steps.detail: Install on a developer test account and verify token refresh and API calls.

steps.title: Onboard first customers (up to 25)
steps.detail: Share the install URL with early customers; get 3 of them active to qualify for listing.

steps.title: Submit the Marketplace listing
steps.detail: Submit one app at a time; a second submission during review is auto-rejected.

review.summary: Marketplace listing review lifts the 25-install cap.
review.meanwhile: Up to 25 installs on marketplace distribution.

blockers.fix: Hit the 25-install cap. Get listed, or use private distribution for a small set of portals.
Another of your apps is already under review; wait for it to finish.

nuances.text: Legacy public apps migrated to the new platform with more than 25 installs have the cap enforced automatically.

uncertainties: Scope names and endpoint URLs were not re-checked against current HubSpot docs in this pass.

sources.title: HubSpot changelog: New marketplace distribution app install limits

corrections: Expected 'no review unless you want a listing'. HubSpot's Sept 2025 change caps unlisted marketplace-distribution apps at 25 installs.
